articles.text: Molina and White continue their visit to the air base with Lieutenant La Cerda. They comment on how cold and changeable the weather is, recall the pleasant weather of the previous day, and talk about taking a ride to the countryside or walking in the park.

A sudden change in the weather brings clouds and wind, so La Cerda suggests going inside for coffee. Molina thanks him but explains they have to leave, and he offers to drive since he brought his car.
